ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 1838 reviews, yet only 2 of 30 ads carry a site proof number. Cold buyers have no reason to trust. Put 1838 reviews on the creative and in line one, then open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers Extra 3% Off on prepaid orders, yet 0 of 19 ads mention it. Buyers who see only free shipping never learn of it. Put 3% off prepaid in line one of three new ads and on the creative.
Your offer appears after 94% of the copy on a median ad of 67 words, so most viewers never reach it. Put the 3% prepaid discount in the first two lines of every ad, and cut the copy that follows it.

Your 3 ads running 60+ days are proven winners, yet none of the 27 newer ads reuses their opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its hook and swapping only the product.
